correctness.rationale: A position swap is forbidden exactly when at least one of the two directed arcs between the positions occurs in the permutation; each two-cycle accounts for one double count. Marking two-cycles in the labelled permutation EGF gives the degree enumerator, and marking a single one gives the handshake formula. Splitting cycles at cyclic separation two and joining pairs of three-cycles give the stated normal forms. Four-label pairing swaps and connectivity on the 44 states of X_5 suffice to connect those forms. At n=4, each of the six odd vertices has two of the three even vertices as neighbors. Viewing those six neighbor pairs as edges of a multigraph on the three even vertices gives degree four at each vertex, hence multiplicity two on each pair. This proves distance two within either sign, and distance at most three across signs; ambient adjacency agrees since the subgraph is induced. For the given witnesses a relative three-cycle has no factorization into two transpositions using any outside position; the first internal swap would create a fixed point. Sign excludes odd lengths. Both four-swap sequences are legal, and extending the n=5 witness by an arbitrary derangement works for n>=7. Finally det(J-I)=(-1)^(n-1)(n-1) gives the sign imbalance that excludes a Hamiltonian path.
residual_risks: The finite census does not establish a general pair-distance law or maximum excess. The all-order conclusions use the combinatorial reductions and witness extension, with a finite base check at n=5.

evidence: Diaconis–Graham–Holmes explicitly state that the two order-three derangements are disconnected and that all derangements are connected by transpositions for n>=4. The chordal-bipartite theorem of Dyer–Jerrum–Müller is not what implies this: three matched index pairs in a crown induce a six-cycle.

0b3ffe565987 treats all three-position restrictions as induced subgraphs of K_{3,3}. When the position set T equals its image set, precisely the two three-cycles survive, of the same sign. a01ace1f3db3 proves a larger distance for simultaneously reversing multiple triangles; the relevant coverage here is one four-swap block inside its constructive proof, not that multi-triangle distance by itself.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The published connectivity result covers the exact family. The local older census and the distinct detour construction determine the obstruction and its remedy; one does not have to infer any statement about all distances from the multi-triangle theorem.

evidence: For a three-cycle reversal, all two-transposition ambient paths stay on its three positions. The q=3 case of 0b3ffe565987 leaves only the two endpoints on that support, excluding a legal two-step path. Such a triangle and an unchanged derangement on its complement exist at every n>=5.

In a01ace1f3db3, the four consecutive swaps in the middle of the ten-move template have form (x,a),(x,c),(x,b),(x,a). On an initial triangle a->b->c->a and an external image x->y, the four swaps give entries (x,a,b,c) successively (b,y,c,a), (a,y,c,b), (c,y,a,b), (y,c,a,b). They reverse just that triangle and restore x->y. Legality requires only that x and y lie outside the triangle and x!=y, independent of the complement's size or cycle type; even n=5 qualifies. Parity then gives exact distance four.

At n=4 the three even derangements have degree four and the six odd ones degree two by the existing degree law; the three-vertex multigraph calculation gives the isometric boundary. The remaining generating-function and parity formulas follow from ordinary cycle marking and the determinant, respectively.

value.rationale: The sharp contrast between ambient and constrained distances is well motivated, but the frozen result uses already available local obstruction and swap constructions, with an elementary smallest-order boundary check. Likewise the mobility specification follows from the existing degree law by standard cycle marking. As submitted, the combination does not leave a distinct exact invariant or a new distance phenomenon beyond those calculations.
residual_risks: This does not assess the value of a genuinely new distance classification or a broader quantitative reconfiguration theorem; neither is the frozen claim.
